values.source_excerpt: rosbridge_library/package.xml:45: <test_depend>tf2_msgs</test_depend>; find/rg over u0344 snapshot: no TFMessage.msg, no tf2_msgs directory, no 'TFMessage' string

notes: The provenance itself concedes the snapshot never names the type, and my checks agree: rg for 'TFMessage' over the whole u0344 snapshot returns nothing, and no TFMessage.msg or tf2_msgs package directory exists. The two cited lines are confirmed verbatim (subscribers.py:98 and ros_loader.py:199) but are generic run-time dynamic-import code that mentions no type name; the leading 'packet element msg:tf2_msgs/TFMessage' is not a location. So msg_type is unverifiable. definition_id hashes a TFMessage.msg fetched from a raw.githubusercontent.com URL (jazzy branch of ros2/geometry2), not a file in the snapshot; network use is out of scope. The one readable snapshot cite, package.xml:45 (<test_depend>tf2_msgs</test_depend>), is accurate but states nothing about the hash value.
